versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules

selection:
  ParentImage: '*\mmc.exe'
  Image: '*\cmd.exe'
exclusion:

condition: selection and not exclusion

versions.subject: Add more exclusions to mmc process rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage: '*\mmc.exe'
exclusion:
    Image: 
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\mmc.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\mmc.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\vmconnect.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\certreq.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\DeviceProperties.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe'
condition: selection and not exclusion
